messages:
sam: quick follow-up from the PM: we still have 3 action items that need named owners + explicit ETAs before I close the loop. want to avoid these drifting into next sprint.

marta: list them pls?

sam: A) canary rollback dry-run + gated toggle (we need a rehearsed path and QA checklist) B) quantized-model fallback config for lower-memory nodes (reduce OOMs during burst) C) postmortem eval harness + KPI regression checks (catch quality drift after sweeping fixes).

devon: I can take A (canary rollback dry-run). will draft the playbook and schedule a rehearsal window. filing INF-4210. ETA: rehearsal + PR by 2026-04-06.

oncall-bot: Created INF-4210 (Canary rollback dry-run + gated toggle) and assigned to devon.

kai: I'll take B (quantized-model fallback). will prototype a fallback profile and run a short smoke matrix. filing INF-4211. ETA prototype 2026-04-08.

pm-bot: Created INF-4211 (Quantized fallback profiles) and assigned to kai.

marta: I can own C (eval harness). will add the regression checklist and a small synthetic prompt set to catch quality regressions. filing INF-4212. ETA tests + baseline 2026-04-04.

pm-bot: Created INF-4212 (Postmortem eval harness + KPI checks) and assigned to marta.

sam: proposed RACI quick sketch:
- A (rollback rehearsals): R=devon, A=oncall, C=eng-runtime/qa, I=customers
- B (quantized fallback): R=kai, A=infra-ml, C=eng-runtime, I=ops
- C (eval harness): R=marta, A=product-lead, C=research, I=ps

devon: backup owners: backup for A = sam.

kai: backup for B = devon.

marta: backup for C = kai.

sam: note recurrence: similar rollback-needed incidents occurred 2x in last 6 weeks during high-throughput ingest to dedicated pools. tag tickets with "recurrence: rollback-needed" and paste the short timeline.

kai: will attach memory traces and the quantization error vs latency table to INF-4211.

pm-bot: INF-4210, INF-4211, INF-4212 linked to PM-2026-03-31 and added to remediation board.

devon: scheduling: need a 90-min QA slot for the dry-run. @marta can you help book with runtime + oncall next Tue?

marta: yes - I'll reserve Tue 11:00-12:30 and invite runtime + qa + oncall.

sam: admins: please set the JIRA "remediation ETA" field and link PRs to the postmortem doc. reply here with ticket numbers + ETAs when set.

kai: INF-4211 ETA 2026-04-08.

marta: INF-4212 ETA 2026-04-04.

devon: INF-4210 ETA 2026-04-06.

sam: thanks all. leaving this thread open until PRs are linked and the dry-run is scheduled. will escalate to platform leads if any cross-team blocker appears by EOD Fri. :white_check_mark:
